title: Canonical witness transport of compact-support exchange
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring, and let $ egin{smallmatrix}X'&\xrightarrow{g'}&X\
f'\downarrow&&\downarrow f\
Y'&\xrightarrow{g}&Y\end{smallmatrix}$ be a Cartesian square of schemes. Fix a compactification $c=(j,p)$ of $f$ and its base change $c'$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Use the derived categories of fixed $\Lambda$-module sheaves on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] and [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules] and their canonical site comparison $
u^*$ [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. Write $F_c^e=Rp_*^e j_!^e$, $F_c^p=Rp_*^p j_!^p$, and $C_c:
u_Y^*F_c^e\xrightarrow{\sim}F_c^p
u_X^*$ for the canonical proper-counit/open-extension comparison, with bounded-below inclusion understood. If $a_v:
u^*v_e^*\xrightarrow{\sim}Lv_p^*
u^*$ is the canonical pullback comparison, define the source and target paths to be $S=(Lg^*C_c)\circ(a_gF_c^e)$ and $T=(F_{c'}^p a_{g'})\circ(C_{c'}g_e'^*)$, with the canonical functor associators. For an actual retained witness $\alpha:
u_X^*L\xrightarrow{\sim}N$ with $L\in D^+(X_{et},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], define its transported exchange by
$$ (F_{c'}^p Lg'^*)(\alpha)\circ T_L\circ
u_{Y'}^*(\operatorname{Ex}_!^{c,e}(L))\circ S_L^{-1}\circ(Lg^*F_c^p)(\alpha^{-1}), $$
where $\operatorname{Ex}_!^{c,e}$ is the specified etale exchange [def-cbc-exchange-map]. These are constructions of paths and an arrow; no invertibility of the exchange or independence of the witness is asserted.

    (N : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)))
    (alpha : (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X).mapDerivedCategory.obj L.obj ≅ N) :
    ((rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) c) ⋙
        (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g).leftDerivedFunctor).obj N ⟶
      ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g').leftDerivedFunctor ⋙
        rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
          (c.ofIsPullback sq)).obj N
